scenes.title: A Surprise from Mom
scenes.summary: Max muses on women's secret weapon over men as Vika receives a surprise message that Max's mother is arriving tomorrow, prompting a frantic cleanup and Max telling Denis to move out.

scenes.title: A Secret from Mom
scenes.summary: Max gives Denis money to buy groceries and flowers for his mother while instructing him to hide that he lives with them, as Senya pines for twenty thousand rubles to buy a red motorboat.

scenes.title: A Room for Twenty Grand
scenes.summary: Denis asks the kitchen crew if anyone is renting out a room, and after Fedya reminds Senya about the motorboat, Senya offers Denis a room in his apartment for twenty thousand rubles.

scenes.title: Rumors at Arcobaleno
scenes.summary: Viktor Barinov warns Lyova that the owner of Arcobaleno is secretly planning to replace Elena Pavlovna, and when Elena leaves for two hours, Barinov vows that she will not leave.

scenes.title: Mom's Arrival and the Shawl
scenes.summary: Max's mother arrives at the apartment wearing a knitted shawl and warmly thanks Vika for knitting it for her birthday, leaving Vika baffled by Max's fib.

scenes.title: The Lie About the Shawl and Borscht
scenes.summary: Vika confronts Max in the kitchen for lying that she knitted the birthday shawl, only for Max's mother to reveal that Max also bragged about Vika's homemade borscht.

scenes.title: Senya's Tall Tale for Marina
scenes.summary: To convince his wife Marina to let Denis move in, Senya invents a tragic story that Denis lost his entire family in a plane crash, and then charges Denis twenty-five thousand rubles in secret.

scenes.title: The New Man at the Restaurant
scenes.summary: While the owner of Arcobaleno shows a young man around the restaurant, Viktor Barinov assumes the newcomer is Elena's replacement and recruits Lyova to scare him away outside.

scenes.title: A Talk in the Car
scenes.summary: Viktor Barinov and Lyova corner the young man in a parked car and threaten him not to work at Arcobaleno, before ducking down when Elena Pavlovna returns to the courtyard.

scenes.title: Elena's Invitation
scenes.summary: Viktor Barinov steps out to greet Elena Pavlovna and is thrilled when she invites him to dinner at their restaurant tomorrow evening, before realizing he broke the window of someone else's car.

scenes.title: The Dropped Stitch
scenes.summary: While looking through childhood photos, Max's mother snags a thread on her shawl and hands Vika knitting needles to fix a couple of stitches, forcing Max and Vika to search online for a tutorial.

scenes.title: A Sudden Migraine
scenes.summary: After Vika accidentally unravels the shawl further, Max advises her to fake a splitting headache until they can find someone at work tomorrow to re-knit the shawl.

scenes.title: Marina's Concern
scenes.summary: When Marina notices how cheerful Denis seems and hears him suggest watching a movie about a plane crash, Senya claims Denis has lost his mind from grief and asks Marina to watch over him.

scenes.title: A Shirt for the Date
scenes.summary: In the middle of a busy service at Arcobaleno, Viktor Barinov pulls Lyova into the office to help him choose the best shirt for his upcoming dinner date with Elena Pavlovna.

scenes.title: Searching for a Knitter
scenes.summary: Max asks Ainura if she knows how to knit so she can fix his mother's unraveled shawl, and when the shawl ends up completely ruined, Max promises Vika he will lie just one last time.

scenes.title: Exposing Senya's Scam
scenes.summary: Marina comes to comfort Denis in his room at night, leading to a hilarious misunderstanding where Denis thinks Senya and Marina are swingers and reveals he is paying twenty-five thousand rubles for the room.

scenes.title: Chasing the Designer
scenes.summary: When the young man returns to Arcobaleno to tell the owner he refuses to work there, Viktor Barinov and Lyova chase him into the kitchen, where the owner catches them in the act.

scenes.title: The Truth About Elena's Departure
scenes.summary: Viktor Barinov confronts the owner for firing Elena Pavlovna, only to learn that the young man was an interior designer, Elena is leaving of her own accord, and she recommended Barinov to replace her.

scenes.title: The New Shawl and the Doorbell
scenes.summary: Max brings home a brand-new shawl and tells his mother that Vika knitted it for her, but their relief turns to panic when Max's mother finds a strange pair of men's briefs and Denis rings the doorbell.

scenes.title: The Bitter Truth and Departure
scenes.summary: Max's mother greets Denis as Max's childhood friend rather than his brother, exposing Max's lie to a furious Vika, while Elena Pavlovna tells Viktor Barinov she must leave so neither of them suffers.
